profile.headline: Pursuer of knowledge, builder, and hopeful creator of the next world changing idea
profile.summary:
I believe that the best teams and individuals share their knowledge and experience with each other. This way, unexpected hurdles are much less likely to occur.

That idea first came to me before enrolling in college. Back then, I had seen projects fail because teams didn't appreciate each other's problem space. I thought that, by studying two fields that were so different (Computer Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering), I could help bridge the gap of knowledge between them. In doing so, I wouldn't have to watch awesome projects falter due to some preventable miscommunication.

It’s a few years later now, and I still hold the same values even though I’m in a slightly different industry. I've worked closely with BAs, QAs, UI, UX, and customers so that I can reach a better understanding of what is needed. My willingness to step outside of my comfort zone and learn new concepts has helped tremendously with this (thank goodness for the internet).

I am also a strong proponent of passing on whatever knowledge and skills I may gain through my own journeys. People who think differently than oneself can come up with the craziest of ideas when given the tools and knowledge to do so. My short time in Malawi and Kenya cemented this ideal, and I hope to go back someday to see how life may have changed since my time there.

Other than continuously learning and sharing my own knowledge, my hobbies include fixing whatever went wrong with my 3D printer, making apps to solve random problems I’ve ran into (web, mobile, desktop), extreme calm water paddleboarding, occasionally writing on Medium, and trying not to sound horrible on a guitar.

My current favorite tools include Docker, Azure, Angular, Asp.NET Core, and Xamarin; and while I’d love to continue my current adventure with those, I’m not afraid of using different technology stacks (my little brother swears by React, after all).

If you’re interested to know more about me or just swap stories, feel free to reach out!

positions.title: Principal Engineer, TLCP
positions.description: Skills: Coaching & Mentoring · Microsoft Azure · Leadership · Software Design · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Communication

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Own boundary between my team's services and external consumers/dependencies.
* Design medium-long term architectural goals and architecture.
* Drive and implement the modernization of our hosting platform to promote scalability, resiliency, and
developer experience (e.g., infrastructure as code, full CI/CD, containerization- where appropriate).
* Create work items (user stories) for team members and define strategic initiatives for longer running service work. Work items follow best practices- measurable/achievable acceptance criteria.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
My general, day-to-day responsibilities include:

* Designing/Writing framework/platform code to ease the development and maintenance of "feature" code.
* Working with business experts and application users to vet feature requests and translate them into actionable designs (some of which I implement, some of which team members take and implement).
* Identify areas of waste (process, service cost, time) and create actionable plans to eliminate or mitigate said waste.
* Maintain and develop my teams' CI/CD tooling.
* Lead team adoption of containers and usage of platform features of AWS.

Additionally, I also work on the following:

* Develop and maintain team best practices around collaboration and tool usage.
* Identify new technology that may allow us to write better applications and services. 
* Propose new architectural designs that improve system stability and maintainability.
* Maintain company wide Probot GitHub Organization

Tools:

* AWS, Terraform, C# (.Net Core, .Net Framework), Javascript (Node.js), Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Buildah, ECS

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
* Implement new backend functionality following our microservice architecture.
* Review code as necessary to maintain the quality of our codebase while remaining open to innersourcing needs.
* Uplift legacy VB and C# functionality where appropriate.
* Maintain legacy VB.Net and .Net applications.
* Promote better collaboration and shared practices through participation on an internal innersourcing Council.
positions.insights: Skills: Coaching & Mentoring · Microsoft Azure · C# · Leadership · Software Design · Communication

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
In addition to my role as a programmer/analyst on the platform team, I also accepted the responsibility of Client Development Lead for our desktop applications. 

Applied well known design patterns to solve problems in a flexible, more modular fashion.

Utilized Azure Public Cloud and related services with the goal of creating a healthcare focused solution.

Drove standardization of user interface development so that it is more consistent, modular, and so that the development velocity of new projects is increased.

Worked as either a full-stack developer or a layer specific developer, depending on the needs of a project.

Honed knowledge of .Net, C#, SQL, WPF, and Azure through participation in MCIS hosted study groups as well as through self-guided learning.
positions.insights: Skills: Coaching & Mentoring · Microsoft Azure · C# · Leadership · Software Design · Communication

positions.title: Process Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Developed a method to determine which tool set (framework, language, etc.) would be best suited for an application/tool request.

Developed an outline for how programming projects should be documented and controlled using Jira and Confluence.

Honed project management skills by: balancing multiple ongoing tasks, analyzing the ROI of projects, and by dealing with changes in project scope. 

Worked independently while taking the initiative to find projects that could improve the quality of the workplace.

Effectively used various means of communication to pull in project resources or general help. This was often done across departments and teams.

Developed applications for internal use in C# and WPF.

positions.title: Quality Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Automated data collection and reporting processes by creating Excel documents that utilized VBA.

Documented steps used to create documents so that they were maintainable.

Utilized time studies to find where process changes will make the most impact.

Applied Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to various processes to improve performance.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Design/build/test a program to use past student records data to predict class enrollment patterns.

Utilized Python 2.7, PyQt, and the Eclipse IDE.

Skills: team based work, goal setting/completion, time management.

positions.title: Supplemental Instructor
positions.description:
I facilitated student learning sessions and helped students better understand concepts or applications of course content. Each semester, I was assigned one course that typically possessed a challenge to newer students. I then attended each class and provided weekly small group sessions covering the course content (lab sessions).

I helped students learn better studying/learning skills by directing them towards self learning resources. If that was not a good fit for the student, I worked with them to develop a teaching style that fits their needs.

Skills: communication, tutoring, self learning, Java, C++, Android, VB, organization planning.

positions.title: Cashier/Stocker
positions.description:
Helped create a plan on how to efficiently organize the undersized backroom for storing all of the products that the store sold.

Was given the responsibility of delegating tasks to other employees (to effectively use their time).

Designed floor layouts for product displays.

Skills: Customer interactions, conflict handling, time management, organizational skills.

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineering Intern
positions.description:
I used a combination of Sketchup and Solidworks to brainstorm and plan machine configurations. 

Solidworks was also used in the planning of machine upgrades to produce a better workflow and to make maintenance work more cost effective.

Designed, machined, and built fixtures to create a safer work environment and also to improve workflow. 

Autocad was used to design floor layouts.

I observed in-place processes and wrote Operator Instructions for the floor techs. In doing so, I also analyzed the processes for possible improvements.

Skills: Operator Instructions, team lead, machining, work flow optimization, time studies, fixture design and build.

positions.title: Mechanical Design Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Populated a webpage using the Concrete5 CMS.
Drew schematics for fire, electrical, and network building plans (AutoCAD).

I taught myself how to use Solidworks Composer to improve my value to the company. I then became the resident expert in the software, which helped generate more sales as Composer was used primarily to create product demonstrations. Later, I presented at a user group meeting on how we used the program in our company.

Skills: Work efficiently, speaking/communicating.

positions.title: IT intern
positions.description:
Started the rebuild of the network infrastructure.
Helped plan/design/build a network/security system for a new plant.
Resolved issues regarding computer malfunction.

Skills: dedication to outstanding results, professionalism, problem solving, employee interactions, troubleshooting, time management, ordering products (inventory)

projects.title: Website Design/Build
projects.description:
As webmaster for a new colony of Pi Lambda Phi Fraternity, it was/is my duty to create a webpage for our chapter.

I have had to learn HTML, CSS, XML, and Javascript. 

I have also honed my design and planning skills through the use of an Idea Notebook in which I drew layouts and wrote other notes regarding helpful information for the website.

organizations.name: Pi Lambda Phi
organizations.position: Director of Communication, Website Coordinator, Historian, Beta Class Member · Mar 2013 - Present
organizations.description: Represent PLP in a professional manner around campus, helped in recruiting new members. Set up PLP's presence at events.
